cd /home/john/mynotes/shadow_frontier && python3 search/render_window.py --base results/window2023w48_lnlam --elo 0.35 --ehi 0.45 --neps 2000 --out viz/fig7e_window2023_w48.png --title "Omega-doubling test: NW=48 (artifact check)" && python3 - <<'PY'
import numpy as np
# compare boundary corner: NW=24 vs NW=48
for tag,f in [("NW=24","results/window2023_lnlam_theta.npz"),
              ("NW=48","results/window2023w48_lnlam_theta.npz")]:
    d=np.load(f); Ds,eps,TH=d['Ds'],d['eps'],d['TH'].astype(float)
    bnd=np.array([eps[np.where(TH[:,i]>=1)[0][-1]] if TH[0,i]>=1 else np.nan
                  for i in range(len(Ds))])
    # locate max curvature of the boundary (the corner)
    sm=np.convolve(bnd,np.ones(21)/21,mode='same')
    curv=np.gradient(np.gradient(sm,Ds),Ds)
    i=np.nanargmin(curv[50:-50])+50
    print(f"{tag}: corner (max |curvature|) at D = {Ds[i]:.4f}, eps = {bnd[i]:.4f}; "
          f"slope left {np.polyfit(Ds[i-80:i-20],bnd[i-80:i-20],1)[0]:.3f}, "
          f"right {np.polyfit(Ds[i+20:i+80],bnd[i+20:i+80],1)[0]:.3f}")
PY
